settings.title: Is your website a brochure or a lead machine?

tabs.tab_content: Both. If your current site has a solid foundation, we’ll improve it. If it’s holding you back, we’ll rebuild it properly.

tabs.tab_title: Will I be able to edit it myself?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. We build on WordPress with a visual editor and train your team on everyday updates.
You do. The domain, the content and the site itself belong to your business.

tabs.tab_title: Do you handle hosting and maintenance?
tabs.tab_content: [CONFIRM] Yes. Hosting, security updates, backups and small changes are part of your plan.

tabs.tab_title: Can I buy Website on its own?
tabs.tab_content: No. Every service is delivered as part of a FirstSearch partnership, because website works best alongside the rest of your marketing system. Your plan includes every service your business needs for one fixed monthly retainer.
